title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons up to version 10.0.4. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
